--- title: >- [store.ChromaDBStore]{.doc-object-name .doc-class .doc-label .doc-label-class} body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 toc-depth: 3 page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} A vector store backed by ChromaDB. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/posit-dev/raghilda/blob/docs-embedding-providers/src/raghilda/_chroma_store.py#L394-L992){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.CLASS} ```python store.ChromaDBStore(client, collection, metadata) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} ChromaDBStore provides local vector storage using Chroma's embedded client. Documents are chunked by raghilda and embeddings are generated by Chroma's embedding function (defaults to Chroma's built-in embedding). ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} ::: {#c7a3aef1 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} from raghilda.store import ChromaDBStore store = ChromaDBStore.create(location="raghilda_chroma", name="docs") store.upsert(markdown_doc) chunks = store.retrieve("hello world", top_k=3) ``` ::: ## Methods {.doc-methods}
Name Description
connect() Connect to an existing ChromaDB store.
create() Create a new ChromaDB store.
retrieve() Retrieve the most similar chunks to the given text.
### [connect()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method} ::: {.doc-subject} Connect to an existing ChromaDB store. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/posit-dev/raghilda/blob/docs-embedding-providers/src/raghilda/_chroma_store.py#L517-L564){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python connect(name, location=None, *, client=None) ``` ::: #### Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [name]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Collection name for the store. [location]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str | Path | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Path where ChromaDB persists its data. Use ":memory:" or None for an in-memory store. [client]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [Any]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Optional pre-configured Chroma client (e.g., HttpClient). ::: #### Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [ChromaDBStore]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : A connected store instance. ::: ### [create()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method} ::: {.doc-subject} Create a new ChromaDB store. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/posit-dev/raghilda/blob/docs-embedding-providers/src/raghilda/_chroma_store.py#L414-L515){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python create( location=None, *, overwrite=False, name=None, title=None, embed=None, collection_metadata=None, attributes=None, client=None ) ``` ::: #### Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [location]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str | Path | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Path where ChromaDB will persist its data. Use ":memory:" or None for an in-memory store. [overwrite]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[False]{.va}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Whether to overwrite an existing collection with the same name. [name]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Collection name for the store. [title]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Human-readable title for the store. [embed]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [(
    EmbeddingProvider
    | chromadb.api.types.EmbeddingFunction[chromadb.api.types.Documents]
    | None
)]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Optional embedding function. Can be either a raghilda EmbeddingProvider (e.g., EmbeddingOpenAI, EmbeddingCohere) or a ChromaDB embedding function. Raghilda providers are adapted internally to Chroma-compatible embedding functions. If None, Chroma's default embedding function is used. [collection_metadata]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [dict[str, Any] | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Additional metadata to attach to the Chroma collection. [attributes]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [AttributesSchemaSpec | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Optional schema for user-defined attribute columns. Attribute names use identifier-style syntax. Chroma also provides built-in filterable columns: `chunk_id`, `start_index`, `end_index`, `char_count`, `context`, and `origin`. [client]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [Any]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Optional pre-configured Chroma client (e.g., HttpClient). ::: #### Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [ChromaDBStore]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : A newly created store instance. ::: ### [retrieve()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method} ::: {.doc-subject} Retrieve the most similar chunks to the given text. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/posit-dev/raghilda/blob/docs-embedding-providers/src/raghilda/_chroma_store.py#L717-L817){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python retrieve(text, top_k, *, deoverlap=True, attributes_filter=None, **kwargs) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Uses ChromaDB's vector similarity search to find relevant chunks, then optionally merges overlapping chunks from the same document. ::: #### Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [text]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : The query text to search for. [top_k]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [int]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : The maximum number of chunks to return. [deoverlap]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[True]{.va}]{.doc-parameter-default} : If True (default), merge overlapping chunks from the same document. Overlapping chunks are identified by their `start_index` and `end_index` positions. When merged, the resulting chunk spans the union of the original ranges, combines metrics, and aggregates attribute values into per-chunk lists in start-order. The `context` value is kept from the first chunk in each merged overlap group. [attributes_filter]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [AttributeFilter | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Optional attribute filter as SQL-like string or dict AST. Example string: `"tenant = 'docs' AND priority >= 2"`. Supports declared attributes plus built-in columns: `chunk_id`, `start_index`, `end_index`, `char_count`, `context`, and `origin`. [**kwargs]{.doc-parameter-name} : Additional arguments passed to ChromaDB's `query()` method. ::: #### Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [Sequence[RetrievedChromaDBMarkdownChunk]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : The retrieved chunks with their relevance metrics. :::
